title: A Study of Decadence
html:
In this video, Link, he talks about decadence and how a society becomes reflective and not passionate. It doesn’t seek to act but philosophize or shelter itself from pain and suffereing. It is always thinking and not doing things.

A society starts being decadent when it stops looking at the stars and drowns itself in wine.

Refer to Finding Passion in a Passionless Age
